provenance.source: Universal Dependencies Ancient_Greek-PROIEL (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0) and Ancient_Greek-Perseus (CC BY-NC-SA 2.5): train+dev+test of both, MINUS the PROIEL sentences of the NT books JOHN MATT ACTS COL 1TIM 3JOHN JAS 2THESS 1COR 1THESS MARK PHIL LUKE TIT REV EPH (hold-out register)
provenance.filter: a form is a member iff, over both treebanks, (1) most of its tokens are UPOS PRON, (2) most of its PRON tokens are third-person personal (PROIEL: Person=3 and PronType=Prs; Perseus has no Person feature, so by the PROIEL majority of the token's lemma), (3) among those third-person tokens Sing outnumbers Plur. Article (UPOS DET) and relative/demonstrative uses make a form like ὁ or τὸν mostly non-PRON, so it is out.
provenance.note: gender and number counts are from the form's third-person personal PRON tokens; normalizePronounClass decides clean (singular-only, one gender, 2+ observations) or soft from them. per-form shares: the sidecar *.shares.json
